title: Turrican
build: Commodore 64 original, PAL, two disk sides from the C64 Preservation Project's 10th Anniversary Collection: turrican_s1 and turrican_s2 [rainbow_arts_1990](pal)(!)

records.c: object type 3, the walking robot (sprites $98-$9B facing left, $9C-$9F right): walks along the ground, its four frames turning every sixth frame; turns round at a wall level with its body, hops up when its feet meet a step (the jump curve at $77F3), and falls off ledges. Shot: an explosion and 100 points. Touching it hurts the hero, unless he is shielded or the wheel, which destroys it. The blast of a mine ($0305 negative; a grenade's blast is the engine's, $030D) knocks it off the screen in a death leap ($A0, $A1), also for 100. It keeps its frame delay, frame, direction and leap step in $BCF0, $BCFB, $BD06 and $BD11
the robot's frame: a hit by a shot ends it at $76B8; in its death leap (state 3) only the leap goes on
the robot destroyed: becomes an explosion (type $80) and gives 100 points
touches the hero? (the box is 20 lines above his feet to 28 below, 6 units either side): shielded or as the wheel he destroys it, otherwise he is hurt
by state: 2 falling (no walking frames), 3 the death leap, 1 walking
a wall beside it at its body's row, on the side it walks to, turns it round
a mine going off ($0305 negative) starts the death leap, with 100 points
on the screen, is there ground under it (the character below its feet)? If not it starts to fall (state 2, the second frame); if there is it lands, its Y put back on the character row
the leap or fall: Y moves by the curve at $77F3 from the step in $BD11 (up 5 first, down 4 at the end); it is removed below the screen
moves one unit left or right; leaving the screen removes it

the robot's first walking shape by direction: $98 left, $9C right
the robot's death-leap shape by direction: $A0, $A1

object type 4, the drone (sprites $A2 to $A5, two frames each way), which comes in from the right or left edge as its state says and drifts across, at random stopping and starting and wandering up and down by up to four lines a frame. Each one sends out up to five more of its kind, one every 32 frames, at its own height, and each of those does the same. One that should come in from the left (state 1) moves left like the others, so it leaves the screen on its first frame and is never seen. Shot, it gives 50 points, or, at every few kills, leaves a diamond worth 200: the count at $BD95, which every new drone sets to 1, so the first one shot after a new one appears always leaves a diamond. Touching it hurts the hero, unless he is shielded or the wheel; flying into a wall destroys it

the drone's start, the second half: a random first vertical speed, -4 to 3, into $BD48, and the timer of its pauses. It sets $BD5E twice, 21 and then 15, and never sets $BD69, the timer of its vertical changes, which starts from whatever the slot's last drone left there
the drone's frame: a hit ends it at $7872, a wall in its middle at $7890
the drone shot: the kill count at $BD95 runs down; at 0 it becomes a diamond (type 2, state $89) for 200 points and the count restarts at a random 1, 3, 5 or 7; otherwise it explodes for 50
the drone explodes, for 50 points
does the drone touch the hero? Shielded or as the wheel he destroys it, otherwise he is hurt
flaps its two frames every sixth frame, and every 32 frames sends out another drone while its five last
moves left by its speed unless paused; the pauses start and stop at random, 1 to 31 frames apart; it is removed at the left edge
moves up or down by its vertical speed unless paused, both changed at random; it is removed off the top or the bottom
the drone's first shape by its state: $A2, $A4
the drone's starting X by its state: $A4 at the right edge, 8 at the left

object type 5, the big bird (sprites $A6 to $AF, a left and a right half side by side, eight frames), which flies in from the right at the height its slot gives ($7B96), steering towards the hero's height and stopping when within 45 units of him. It has 7 points of energy; each hit takes off what the weapon does ($0720) and blacks it out for a frame. Every 60 frames it fires a missile (sprites $B0, $B1). Destroyed it gives 250 points. Touching it hurts the hero, unless he is shielded. State 1 is the left half, 2 the right half, 0 a missile
the bird's start: takes a second slot for its right half (state 2) 12 units to the right, shapes $A6 and $A7, white
touches the hero? The box comes from $7B88 and $7B8B by state; shielded, he destroys it, otherwise he is hurt
by state: 0 a missile ($7B44), 2 the right half, which does nothing of its own, 1 the bird
a hit takes the weapon's damage off its energy; below 0 it is destroyed ($7A62); otherwise both halves black for a frame and a sound
the bird destroyed: both halves explode, 250 points
both halves white again; every third frame the next of its eight frames ($7B8E)
steers its Y towards the hero's, keeping 10 lines of play; on the screen, fires a missile every 60 frames: type 5, state 0, sprite $B0, a sound
moves left one unit a frame, unless it is within 45 units right of the hero; it is removed at the left edge
the bird's missile: flickers between $B0 and $B1, through the colours at $7B80, and flies left two units a frame until it leaves the screen
the bird leaves the screen: both slots freed
the missile's eight colours, read from the end: white, yellow, light red, orange, red, light red, orange, yellow
half the height of the box that hurts the hero, by state: missile 12, bird 10, right half 7
half the width of the box, by state: missile 20, bird 10, right half 8

object type 6, the falling boulder (sprites $B2 to $B7, six frames of its tumble), which drops from the top of the screen, three to six lines a frame, and drifts left. On the ground, or shot (50 points), it bursts into three fragments (state 1, sprites $B8 to $BB) that fly up and out and fall away. While it falls it drops five more boulders at random places, one every 80 frames. Touching a boulder or a fragment hurts the hero, unless he is shielded or the wheel, which bursts it
the boulder's frame: a hit gives 50 points and bursts it ($7BF6); ground under it bursts it too
bursting: a boulder (state 0) sends out three fragments, each with a random sideways speed of -4 to 3 and a random shape, then becomes an explosion
touches the hero? The box comes from $7D4B and $7D4D by state
a fragment (state 1) flies at $7D15; a boulder drops another every 80 frames while it has any left, at a random X, then tumbles through its six frames every fourth frame
moves left one unit; it is removed at the left edge; falls by its speed, from $22 if it is still above the screen
a fragment: moves by its sideways speed and by the curve at $7D4F, rising first and then falling faster; it is removed off the screen
half the height of the box that hurts the hero: boulder 20, fragment 10
half the width of the box: boulder 10, fragment 4
a fragment's Y step over 30 frames: -7 up to 0 and on to 10 down; the hidden bonus block's prizes fly on it too
the count of fragments still to send out, at $7C01

object type 7, the gun turret (sprites $BC to $BF, turning every fourth frame), fixed in the scenery. It has 4 points of energy: each hit takes off what the weapon does ($0720), with a white flash and a sound, and destroyed it gives 100 points. Every 80 frames (the first after 20) it fires an enemy bullet (type 18) upwards, one line a frame, and sideways by -2, -1, 0 or 1 at random. Touching it hurts the hero, unless he is shielded or the wheel, which destroys it

object type 9, the flying machine (sprites $C5 and $C6 side by side), which drifts about the top of the screen at random. It has 4 points of energy, flashing white when hit; destroyed it gives 500 points. Every 40 frames, while it is high on the screen, it fires a fan of five enemy bullets downwards ($81FA, $81FF). Touching it hurts the hero, unless he is shielded

object type 10, the big walker (four sprites, 2 by 2: $C8-$CB facing left, $CC-$CF right), which waits until the hero comes within 40 units to its left, then roams the screen at random, always facing him. It has 80 points of energy, flashing white when hit. Every 30 frames it fires a missile (state 3, sprites $D0 and $D1) towards the side it faces. Destroyed, it gives 1000 points and bursts into brown fragments (state 4) from every free slot. Touching it hurts the hero, unless he is shielded. Its variables are single bytes ($BEEC-$BF18), so only one can be alive at a time. State 0 is one of its other three sprites

object type 11, the hidden bonus block: invisible until a shot hits its place, then a solid block (sprite $C7) that the hero can stand on and that bounces when he jumps up into it. Every fifth hit flashes it white with a sound and throws out a prize (kind 0 to 7 at random: a weapon, the shield, P, G, M or L, 500 points each) that flies up and out on the curve at $7D4F and then becomes a real bonus symbol. After ten prizes, the next fifth hit blows it up for 5000 points: 55 hits in all
